visual_review.light_native: Readable as a small upright bulb inside a broad adjustment arc; the outlined indicator remains visibly hollow.
visual_review.dark_native: White-on-dark rendering preserves the same silhouette, openings, and spacing.
visual_review.large: Arc joins are tangent-continuous, bulb geometry is vertically mirrored, and negative space remains balanced around the deliberately asymmetric indicator.
visual_review.symmetry: The bulb is symmetric about x=21; the full composition is deliberately asymmetric to preserve the right-side brightness indicator.
